messages:
Aisha Khan: Morning — flagging a renewal risk with ZenithHealth. They've reported repeated webhook timeouts and slow doc ingestion; adoption metrics dropped ~30% last week. CSM call booked for tomorrow 10am PT. Ticket: https://zendesk.company/agent/tickets/4571 — JIRA CS-921. What I did: pulled logs from the customer org and got a small repro. Blocker: not sure if this is routing/infra or model variant performance. Can someone spare ~1h for async triage today?

Ben Chu: saw similar timeout spikes in staging yesterday around the same time window. I can look 10–11am PT. Quick question — do we want to consider rolling back to the previous model variant if we see degradation?

Lina Gomez: I can run a quick profiler on inference nodes. Need request IDs + a small sample payload to reproduce locally. Aisha — can you paste one sample here?

Aisha Khan: pasted a small sample below (redacted). Repro is a 2.4k token document + metadata header. Error snippet: 
```
2025-08-12T17:12:03Z ERROR ingestion: webhook timeout: 504 (org=zenith-82)
req_id=ab12f4c3 user=zenith-admin
```
Sample payload: 
```json
{"doc_id":"redacted-123","text":"<long clinical notes truncated>","metadata":{"org_id":82,"source":"ehr"}}
```

Samir Patel: I'm on-call today and started a quick tail of the infra metrics. I can add a temporary routing rule to send Zenith to quantized-evm-8 (lower latency, small quality delta) to verify if model variant is the cause. That would be a canary and reversible. Good idea?

Ben Chu: +1 to canary. But confirm with PM/CSM about acceptable quality tradeoff. Also need to coordinate with Dedicated pools if the customer is on reserved capacity.

Aisha Khan: Customer explicitly prefers latency > quality for now — they told me that in the last call. PM gave verbal OK for a temporary canary if we inform them.

Lina Gomez: I'll queue a 1% canary for org 82 to quantized-evm-8. ETA ~45m. I need someone to watch latency and token error rates. Can ops-bot post the canary metrics?

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: org=82 -> model=quantized-evm-8 at 2025-08-12T18:10:00Z. Applied to 1% of traffic. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/abc/zenith-org?orgId=82
Metrics snapshot at deploy time: p50 latency=420ms p95=1.2s errors=0.8%

Samir Patel: Monitoring now — adding an alert for p95 > 2s or error rate delta > 0.5%. Will post updates every 15m.

Ben Chu: If the canary shows improvement, what's the plan to increase traffic? Ramp plan?

Lina Gomez: Ramp plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10–15m gaps, manual checks at each step. Rollback if p95 increases or quality regressions flagged by CS test prompts.

Aisha Khan: I'll run a short prompt set during the ramp and report any quality complaints immediately. Also prepping the customer message to set expectations.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: org=82 p95_latency_threshold=2000ms. Notification: #customer-success on-call.

Samir Patel: First 15m: p95 down from 1.9s to 1.5s for sampled requests. Error rate steady. Continuing to watch.

Lina Gomez: good — I'll proceed to 10% in 12m if trends hold. Posting playbook steps: 
1) apply routing canary 
2) validate latencies and error rate 
3) run 5 prompt-quality checks from CS prompt set 
4) if pass, ramp to next percentage

Ben Chu: Noted. I'll prepare rollback script if needed: `scripts/rollback-routing.sh org 82`.

Aisha Khan: Thanks all — appreciate the quick reaction. Will keep CS execs updated. If the canary stabilizes, this should remove the renewal risk for the call.

Samir Patel: Update in 20m with full metrics.

Ben Chu: pinging @Lina in 12m for the 10% step.

Aisha Khan: :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll post customer-facing note after 2nd ramp check.
